title: EX Champion Mipha's Song
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|This article is about the Main Quest in {{BotW}}. For other uses, see [[Champion Mipha's Song]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= [[File:BotW EX Champion Mipha's Song.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |type= Main |game= BotW |giver= [[Monk|???]] |location= Ja'Abu Ridge |prereq= Complete [[Great Plateau]] trials |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Mipha's Grace +}} |previous= |next= }} "'''EX Champion Mipha's Song'''" is a [[Main Quest]] in {{BotW}}. It is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|EX Champion Mipha's Song||Series, BotW}} | {{BotW}} }} ==Overview== Once Link has finished the trials on the [[Great Plateau]] during "[[EX The Champions' Ballad]]", the [[One-Hit Obliterator]] will split into four glowing orbs and scatter to different areas of [[Hyrule Kingdom]], revealing four ancient structures called [[Monument]]s. One of the Monuments appears on [[Ja'Abu Ridge]] overhanging the south side of the [[East Reservoir Lake]]. As Link approaches the Monument, a voice belonging to an unspecified [[Monk]] speaks to him and instructs him to complete the trials that will appear to him, as they will enhance his power.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|I applaud your courage in coming here. The locations that will be revealed to you are of trials that will enhance the power sleeping within. Do not let your guard down...}}|Monk|BotW}} Three maps then appear on the Monument's pillars, each revealing the location of a trial that Link must undergo. [[Kass]], who is standing nearby, remarks on either the Monument or the flash of light, depending on how many Monuments Link has already visited.{{Cite|What was that...flash of light? Perhaps it was my imagination playing tricks on me.|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|Did that {{Color BotW|Blue|stone monument}} just start glowing? I suppose that proves I didn't imagine it the first time.|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|This {{Color BotW|Blue|stone monument}} has survived for 10,000 years. What secrets does it hold...|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|That light... Is it a reaction to someone nearby? Is it me...or is it...|Kass|BotW}} Noticing Link, Kass asks why he has come to such a remote area.{{Cite|Hm? Fellow traveler... What brings you here? I suppose everyone has their own reasons for traveling.|Kass|BotW}} He directs Link's attention to the Monument, as it was mentioned in his teacher's [[Unfinished Song]].{{Cite|Look at that! There's one here too! One of the {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}} mentioned in my teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}}.|Kass|BotW}}{{Note|If this is the first Monument that Link has visited, Kass will explain that it was mentioned in an Unfinished Song written by his teacher.{{Cite|This {{Color BotW|Blue|monument}}... I must admit it has taken me by surprise! My teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}} mentions such {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}}, and now one has appeared before my eyes...|Kass|BotW}} At Link's confusion, Kass explains that it is missing its key verses.{{Cite|[Unfinished song?] Yes. The song is mostly complete. However... My teacher left this world without finishing the {{Color BotW|Blue|key verses}}.|Kass|BotW}} He is now on a journey to finish the song.{{Cite|I wish the weave the missing pieces together and finish the song.|Kass|BotW}}}} He reveals that there is a verse in the song that mentions the trials that the [[Zora]] [[Champion]], [[Mipha]], overcame,{{Cite|The song my teacher left behind... There's {{Color BotW|Blue|a verse}} about the trials that {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Mipha}} overcame.|Kass|BotW}} Kass sings the verse for Link,{{Cite|Allow me to sing it for you...|Kass|BotW}} which provides instructions for the trials he will have to face.{{Cite|♪Reaching skyward from waters blue.
{{Color BotW|Blue|Ruta}}'s Champion a heart true.♪
♪The hero's power shall grow.
Seek trials {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}} show.♪
♪One, {{Color BotW|Red|find what the light's path shows}}.
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|conquer ancient foes}}.♪
♪Three, {{Color BotW|Red|chase rings of the waterfall}}.
Champion, the trials call!♪|Kass|BotW}} After the singing the verse, Kass asks Link if he was moved by it.{{Cite|...So? Did it move you?|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|...So? Did the {{Color BotW|Blue|verse}} move you? It was written in honor of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion}} challenging the trial.|Kass|BotW}} Through learning about the Champions, Kass believes his is closer to finishing the key verses.{{Cite|By steeping myself in legends of the {{Color BotW|Blue|Champions}}, I'm beginning to form a deeper understanding of them. This will prove invaluable in writing the {{Color BotW|Blue|key verses}} of the song.|Kass|BotW}} He feels as though his teacher sang the verse in this place before him,{{Cite|I can feel it... My teacher surely sang this very verse from this very spot...|Kass|BotW}} and he once again affirms his desire to complete the Unfinished Song.{{Cite|I wish nothing more than to carry on my teacher's dream to complete and perform this special song.|Kass|BotW}} After visiting [[Zora's Domain]], Kass was able to hear stories of [[Mipha]] from [[Sidon]] and [[King Dorephan]].{{Cite|To do so, I must learn all there is to know about the Champions of old... Thankfully, {{Color BotW|Blue|the Zora king and prince}} shared memories of their Champion with me.|Kass|BotW}} His ultimate goal is to sing the finished song under the sky, which was beloved by his teacher.{{Cite|To sing the completed song under this sky that my teacher so loved...that is the end goal of this long journey.|Kass|BotW}} When he is done speaking, the [[Main Quest]] will begin. Link may complete the three trials in any order. The marker for the first trial guides Link to a cliff in the [[Akkala Highlands]], overlooking [[Knuckel Island]] and [[Ankel Island]]. Here Link finds [[Muzu]] who reveals that Mipha's notes mention that the path of light should be followed when the sun is rising.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Princess Mipha}}'s notes contained a phrase related to the trial... "While the {{Color BotW|Red|morning sun}} is newly born, follow the {{Color BotW|Red|Path of light}} to the trial."|Muzu|BotW}} During the sunrise, a path of light, the sun's reflection on the water, leads to a [[Glowing Ring]] in the [[Lanayru Sea]]. Going through this Ring causes [[Kee Dafunia Shrine]] to rise from beneath the water. The second trial involves defeating the [[Blue-Eyed Guardian]]s in [[Upland Zorana]].{{Cite|Apparently, those {{Color BotW|Red|blue-eyed Guardians}} last appeared when {{Color BotW|Blue|Lady Mipha}} challenged her sacred trial.|Bazz|BotW}} After defeating the three [[Guardian Skywatcher]]s and one [[Guardian Turret]], [[Sato Koda Shrine]] will emerge from the ground. The third trial tasks Link with following a path of Glowing Rings from the western shore of [[Mikau Lake]], up both of its [[Waterfall]]s, across to [[Lulu Lake]], up its Waterfall, and finally to [[Ploymus Mountain]], revealing [[Mah Eliya Shrine]]. Each of these [[Ancient Shrine]]s rewards Link with one of [[Ruta's Emblem]] upon their completion.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Your resourcefulness in overcoming this trial speaks to the promise of a hero. In the name of the Goddess Hylia, I bestow upon you this gift... Ruta's Embelm.}}|Monk|BotW}} The Monk of the Shrine will then inform Link that collecting all three Emblems will unlock a new challenge.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Collect three emblems to open the path to a new challenge.}}|Monk|BotW}} They will tell Link how many more trials he has to complete before fading away.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Two remain...}}|Monk|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|One remains...}}|Monk|BotW}} After completing all three Ancient Shrines, the third Monk will instruct Link to go to [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]].{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Now that you have collected three emblems, you must go to Divine Beast Vah Ruta...}}|Monk|BotW}} As Link approaches the [[Divine Beast]], he is spoken to again by an unspecified Monk, who gives him a trial in exchange for the three Emblem.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|To the one who approaches this Divine Beast... In the name of the Goddess Hylia, I offer this trial. In exchange for Ruta's Emblems... you will be granted the chance to tread through the realm of memories. Those who lack determination will find this trial unforgiving.}}|Monk|BotW}} The Monk warns him not to dismiss it as a figment of his mind, as there is a deeper truth to it.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Do not take this place lightly nor dismiss it as merely a world within your mind. The truth is much deeper than you know.}}|Monk|BotW}} Link is then transported to the [[Illusory Realm]], a realm created by his memories, where he once again battles [[Waterblight Ganon]] inside Divine Beast Vah Ruta.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|This illusory realm was created from the depths of your memories... The enemy you shall face is a product of the fear that dwells within. This battle is a trial of the soul. You must emerge victorious using only the tools provided.}}|Monk|BotW}} This Waterblight Ganon is a phantasm born from Link's memories and fears.{{Cite|You defeated the phantasm of Waterblight Ganon, which was born from your own memories and fears.|Adventure Log|BotW}} Link's equipment, [[Armor]], and [[Inventory]] will be changed to the following: * [[Lightscale Trident]] * Two [[Ceremonial Trident]]s * [[Silver Bow]] * 10 [[Arrow]]s * [[Zora Set]] (upgraded twice) * [[Hyrule Bass]] * [[Hylian Shroom]] * [[Fleet-Lotus Seeds]] After defeating the phantasm, Link is transported back outside of Divine Beast Vah Ruta, where Kass has now landed. Noticing that Link is no longer lost in thought,{{Cite|Oh? My, my. For some, the best part of traveling alone is the freedom to get lost in thought with only the wind to distract you.|Kass|BotW}} Kass informs him that learning about Mipha has inspired him to write a song in her honor.{{Cite|Ah! Wandering around here and listening to anecdotes about {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Mipha}} has truly invigorated me. In fact, it has inspired me to honor her in my own way, separate from my teacher's {{Color BotW|Blue|unfinished song}}. That is why I felt inclined to roost here, near the {{Color BotW|Blue|Divine Beast Vah Ruta}}, which {{Color BotW|Blue|Mipha}} herself mastered. I've written a song...to try and capture the essence of {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Mipha}}...|Kass|BotW}} When he sings the song to Link, at allows him to visualize the "[[Champion Mipha's Song (Memory)|Champion Mipha's Song]]" [[Recovered Memory]].{{Cite|♪Recall the Champion of {{Color BotW|Blue|Ruta}}'s wrath,
before she walked her chosen path.♪
♪{{Color BotW|Blue|Mipha}}'s kindness was known to all,
which is why the princess came to call.♪|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|Kass's composition, entitled {{Color BotW|Red|Champion Mipha's Song}}, was so true and moving that it allowed you to visualize a memory from 100 years ago.|Adventure Log|BotW}} After singing, Kass notes that, while Mipha was kind, she could also be strict.{{Cite|Hmm... Though she was known for her kindness, it seems the Zora princess could be quite strict when necessary.|Kass|BotW}} He asks Link what he thought of "[[Champion Mipha's Song (Song)|Champion Mipha's Song]]",{{Cite|So? What did you think of {{Color BotW|Blue|Champion Mipha's Song}}?|Kass|BotW}} which he reveals makes him feel closer to his teacher.{{Cite|By writing a song that captures the determination of Champion Mipha, I feel closer than ever to my dear teacher.|Kass|BotW}} Kass has realized that he is the only one who can complete his teacher's Unfinished Song.{{Cite|I was struck by a realization...that the missing parts of the song can only be finished by my teacher's pupil. By me.|Kass|BotW}} Link then hears the voice of Mipha, who notices he is now stronger and allows him to use [[Mipha's Grace]] more often.{{Cite|You're so strong...so much stronger than before. The power of Mipha's Grace will now recharge much faster.|Mipha|BotW}} With his power, Mipha believes he is capable of saving both Hyrule and [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]].{{Cite|As powerful as you are, I am certain that you can save Hyrule...as well as the princess who awaits you.|Mipha|BotW}} He then receives [[Mipha's Grace +]], which reduces the ability's recharge time to eight minutes. After this, the Main Quest is completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | The scattered One-Hit Obliterator led you to a location where a stone monument with a map of trials appeared. You still have {{Color BotW|Red|one}} trials to complete. |- | 4 | You completed the three trials inscribed on the stone monument in the Lanayru region.

After you collected three of Ruta's Emblems, the monk told you to head to the Divine Beast. What awaits you there?

Go to the Divine Beast Vah Ruta to find out. |- | Complete | You defeated the phantasm of Waterblight Ganon, which was born from your own memories and fears.

Kass's composition, entitled {{Color BotW|Red|Champion Mipha's Song}}, was so true and moving that it allowed you to visualize a memory from 100 years ago.

By conquering the trial, your sacred power has increased and Mipha's Grace has become more efficient than ever. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * EX Champion Daruk's Song * EX Champion Revali's Song * EX Champion Urbosa's Song * EX The Champions' Ballad * Ja'Abu Ridge * Monument }} {{Notes}} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|EX Champion Mipha's Song}}
